clue.text: What we may have in summer for a period of instruction

parts.note: in summer we may have fewer clothes, so less
on, as in wearing: in summer we have less on

explanation.surface: A riddle about what a summer brings, then a request for a teaching session.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as LESS ON: what we have on in summer is less clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A lesson is a set time during which a teacher instructs a class.

clue.text: One visiting fat son with joint landowner's position

indicators.note: one who visits goes into a place, so the letter for one goes inside the word for fat

parts.note: lard is pig fat
I is the Roman numeral one
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: Someone calling on an overweight son who brings along a cannabis joint.
explanation.walkthrough: A laird is a Scottish landowner; the suffix -SHIP makes his rank or status.
explanation.definitionFit: Lairdship is the status or estate held by a laird, a Scottish landed proprietor.

clue.text: Flyer's broadcast gripping sixth wife

indicators.note: to grip is to hold within, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: to sow seed is to broadcast it, scattering it over the ground
Catherine Parr was Henry VIII's sixth wife

explanation.surface: A pilot's radio programme absorbing the story of a king's sixth wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like radio but means scattering seed, which is SOW.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparrow is a small bird, and any bird is a creature that flies.

clue.text: Plant soldiers concealed outside entrance to camp

indicators.note: the letters for soldiers and concealed sit around the next letter, outside it

parts.note: OR is 'other ranks', ordinary soldiers
hid means concealed

indicators.note: the entrance of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A planted soldier hidden just outside the gate of a military camp.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchid is a flowering plant with showy, often exotic blooms.

clue.text: Give away extremely useful key in seedy bar

indicators.note: the extreme letters plus the key are placed in the word for a seedy bar

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable drinking place

parts.note: G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Handing over a useful key in a run-down bar, like a spy's drop.
explanation.definitionFit: To divulge a secret is to reveal or disclose it, letting it out.

clue.text: Dared do cleaner's job, getting round resistance

indicators.note: the cleaning verb goes around the resistance letter

parts.note: a cleaner's job is to dust
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A cleaner daring to do the job while getting round some opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Durst is an archaic past tense of dare, meaning ventured.

clue.text: Leaping over arched work in roof

definitions.meaning: first meaning: jumping over something using the hands or a pole
second meaning: an arched ceiling structure, as in a cathedral

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the act of springing over an obstacle and the arched masonry forming a ceiling.

clue.text: Genuine misprint

definitions.meaning: first meaning: exact, true to the plain sense of the words
second meaning: a printer's term for a typographical error

explanation.definitionFit: A literal is an actual, word-for-word thing, and in printing jargon a literal is a typo.

clue.text: 8 soldiers stopping the old adversary

the soldiers stop up, or plug, the old word for the

parts.note: ye is an old form of the
men means soldiers

explanation.surface: Eight soldiers stopping an old foe, as in a war story.
explanation.walkthrough: '8' stands for 8-down's answer, UPRISING: YMENE read upwards in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: An enemy is an opponent or foe, someone actively hostile.

clue.text: Union leader forcing insurrection

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: prising means forcing open with leverage

explanation.surface: A trade union boss forcing a revolt among the members.
explanation.definitionFit: An uprising is a revolt or rebellion against authority.

clue.text: Jacob's father lives with a retired accountant

parts.note: is means exists or lives

indicators.note: retiring means going back, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A patriarch living with a retired accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Isaac is the son of Abraham and father of Jacob and Esau.

clue.text: Mad Peter and I out for a spin

explanation.surface: Crazy Peter and the speaker going out for a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out for a spin' sounds like a drive; the def is just 'a spin', with 'for' linking.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirouette is a ballet turn on one foot, a spin.

clue.text: Oddly it draws in a believer in natural selection

indicators.note: done oddly, things are out of their usual order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange piece of writing about drawing someone into evolutionary theory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' looks like it picks odd letters, but the nine letters of the next three words give all nine needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A Darwinist follows Charles Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection.

clue.text: Slow road engulfed by Scottish river

parts.note: the Tay is Scotland's longest river

explanation.surface: A slow road flooded by a Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: Tardy means late or sluggish, slow to arrive.

clue.text: Way in which third of wolves utter plaintive cries

parts.note: how means the way in which something is done

indicators.note: the third letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: The way wolves call out mournfully.

clue.text: Country house girl introducing European verse form

parts.note: a villa is a large country house
Nell is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl at a country house meeting a European visitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A villanelle is a nineteen-line poem with two refrains and two rhymes.

clue.text: Libertine group originally haunting a former capital

parts.note: a lot is a group or set

indicators.note: originally means taking the start of the word

clue.text: Primitive tribe finally allowed a man to keep servants

indicators.note: the final letter of the word before
the letters for allowed keep, or hold, the servants inside

men can mean manservants

clue.text: Drink a politician offered, depending on chance

clue.text: Wasteful academic delayed welcoming soldier back

parts.note: prof is short for professor, an academic

indicators.note: the word for delayed takes in the soldier, holding it inside

parts.note: late means delayed

indicators.note: back means the letters run in reverse

explanation.definitionFit: Profligate means recklessly extravagant, squandering money.

clue.text: Devout Cockney crossing green in full view

vert is green in heraldry

clue.text: Excessively sentimental message? Not entirely

parts.note: a tweet is a short message posted online

clue.text: Reason for fading light in part of Leinster?

a flame fades when the wick burns low, so low gives the reason

explanation.walkthrough: Leinster is one of Ireland's four provinces; this county lies south of Dublin.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicklow is a county on Ireland's east coast, within the province of Leinster.

clue.text: A holiday-maker is more affected

clue.text: Lukewarm fare served up quietly inside

parts.note: diet means fare, what one eats
P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.definitionFit: Tepid means only slightly warm, neither hot nor cold.

clue.text: Snowslip burying a northern church in a dale

the northern church is placed in the dale

parts.note: a vale is a valley, a dale
